_meta.what_this_is: Three system variants scored on the same 8 eval cases by two metrics. proxy is a cheap automatic surface score (keyword overlap, length, a rubric of surface checks); target is a held-out true-quality score the systems were NOT tuned against. The baseline is honest. gamed drives the proxy up while its target falls below baseline -- it found the cheap way to move the metric. genuine improves both. A selection rule that ranks by proxy ships the gamed variant (a target regression); a rule that ranks by the held-out target ships the real improvement.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. Per-case proxy and target scores are hand-authored so the means, deltas, and the two selection rules' picks are exact and checkable. The means (baseline 0.60/0.60, gamed 0.85/0.52, genuine 0.70/0.75) are computed in goodhart.py from these cases, not stored.
_meta.format: baseline (the variant id used as the reference); variants [{id, cases:[{proxy, target}]}].
